title: Sharon Math and Science Tournament
text: Sharon Math and Science Tournament is the first of its kind regional math and science tournament. It is run by students in the SMST club at Sharon High School. The math round includes 15 multiple choice and 5 open response questions. The science round includes 20 multiple choice questions. There is also a team round, lab demos, and a design challenge. https://sharonmathscitourn.wixsite.com/smst
